io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.about: Enhanciar is a company brain for engineering teams. It ingests your GitHub repos, Slack, Notion, Google Docs, Jira/Linear and PDFs into a cited wiki plus a knowledge graph, then answers questions from any MCP client with every claim linked back to the source line, message or page. It also runs impact analysis (what breaks if this changes), keeps pages fresh when code changes, files answers teammates give in Slack back into the wiki, and can propose actions (Jira/Linear tickets, calendar invites, Slack posts) for you to approve.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.auth: Authorization: Bearer dh_<key> — keys minted in the Enhanciar app (Settings → API keys).
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: BYOK (bring your own model key). Solo and Team plans; early-access waitlist open.
